technique_name: Describe a common problem during remote software debugging and how it can be solved.
description: One common problem with remote software debugging is the lack of direct access to the environment when debugging a problem. This can make it difficult to accurately identify and diagnose issues. Solutions to this problem include using remote debugging tools such as Remote Desktop, setting up a remote logging server to capture application information, or using a version control system to keep track of changes and roll back if necessary.
